_note: Editable projection assumptions for cost/calculator.py. Measured pilot values are read from pilot_run.json and pilot_calls.jsonl and are never changed by these settings.

reference_calls.description: Saved GPT-6 Luna calls from the earlier full-corpus run (50-review batches; its other evidence is in archive/v2_full_run_evidence/), used before the final run for per-request token and duration percentiles at production batch size. One row per request ID. The final run's measured totals are in cost/full_run_v4_actuals.md.

base._route_fraction: measured = pilot eligible texts / distinct texts, capped at controls.max_fallback_fraction; cap = the cap itself

sources.local_seconds_per_1000_distinct_texts: Full run: local finalization 79 s + 4.8 s + 110.4 s for 484,189 distinct texts (archive/v2_full_run_evidence/cost/full_run_actuals.json, earlier full run) = 0.40 s per 1,000; the conservative case doubles it.
sources.fixed_local_seconds: Full run: ingest 19.4 s + export 6.6 s + rank 0.5 s + embedding and clustering about 180 s (adopted grouping took 349.6 s including about 170 s of Luna naming requests) = about 210 s; the conservative case doubles it.
sources.group_requests: Full run: 13 successful + 1 failed naming request for the adopted grouping (565 evidence texts).
sources.verification_rows: min(maximum, max(minimum, sample_fraction x nonempty rows)) from config/pipeline.json.
